item.title: AI Demand Lifts Electronics and Electrical Equipment Prices Above 5% Year on Year
item.description:
China's National Bureau of Statistics said on November 16 that rapid AI development is moving from technical innovation into industrial deployment, lifting demand in electronics and electrical machinery. In October, producer prices for electrical machinery and computers/communications equipment rose 0.1% month on month and 6.2% and 5.9% year on year respectively, together contributing about 1.18 percentage points to PPI growth. It is an official data point directly linking AI demand to industrial price increases.

原文标题：AI 需求拉动电子电气行业价格同比涨超 5%

Why it matters：官方统计口径首次将 AI 产业需求与工业品价格上行直接挂钩，是观察 AI 算力与硬件产业链景气度的宏观信号。

item.title: DeepSeek Caps Long Chats and Daily Quota as Compute Strain Bites
item.description:
DeepSeek has imposed usage caps on its app and web client, dropping long conversations inactive for over seven days, cutting single-input length to roughly 40,000 characters and limiting daily conversation quotas with a server-busy notice once exhausted. The move extends a stretch of compute strain: eight service outages since October, against weekly V4.1 Flash calls surging 801% to 33.6 trillion tokens on OpenRouter.

原文标题：DeepSeek 因算力紧张对长对话与日额度实施限额

Why it matters：头部开源模型厂商因算力瓶颈直接收缩 C 端服务，是观察 AI 推理供给紧张与需求爆发的典型信号。

item.title: SK hynix and Korean Government to Build 12-Inch Chip Testing Platform
item.description:
SK hynix, the city of Yongin and South Korea's Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy are jointly building TRINITY FAB, an 8,746 billion KRW project inside the Yongin Y1 fab cluster with 3,300 square meters of cleanroom space for 37 front-end tools. The facility will give Korean materials, components and equipment suppliers a production-grade 12-inch process validation platform, with completion expected in May 2027 and evaluation services starting later that year.

原文标题：SK 海力士联手韩国政府共建 12 英寸测试验证平台

Why it matters：这是韩国半导体供应链本土化的重要基础设施投入，为设备与材料厂商提供量产级验证平台，对关注算力上游供应链的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Amap Launches Cloud-Controlled Traffic Light System in Beijing Pilot
item.description:
Amap has launched a cloud-controlled traffic light system that uses spatial intelligence to sense traffic in real time and dynamically recommend signal timing, without adding roadside cameras or other hardware. Deployed at nearly 100 intersections in Beijing's Chaoyang and Fengtai districts in partnership with local traffic police, the pilot cut average vehicle stop time by 19.4% and raised throughput by 19%.

原文标题：高德发布云控红绿灯系统 北京近百路口试点

Why it matters：这是空间智能在智慧交通领域的规模化落地案例，具备明确实测数据与可复制的轻量化技术路径。

item.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen4 Max with 9-Point Intelligence Index Gain
item.description:
Alibaba launched Qwen4 Max, which scores 43 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at xhigh reasoning effort, a 9-point gain over Qwen3.8 Max and just 3 points behind Kimi K3.1 Pro. Cost per task drops to $3.27, roughly one-third of its predecessor and about 11% below Kimi K3.1 Pro, driven by 25% lower per-token pricing, 70% cheaper cache hits and 39% fewer output tokens.

原文标题：阿里发布 Qwen4 Max 智能指数跃升 9 分

Why it matters：头部开源系厂商旗舰模型换代，性能与成本双线大幅改善，是模型竞争格局的重要节点。

item.title: Orico Launches FlashMem FM9800 SSD with pSLC AI Cache Zone
item.description:
Orico has launched the FlashMem FM9800 SSD, built on 3D TLC NAND with a portion of flash configured in pSLC mode to form an AI Cache zone that holds local AI model weights, context, and inference intermediate data. The PCIe Gen5 drive comes in 768GB+85GB and 1638GB+128GB configurations and pairs with AI storage middleware and the Herdsman local inference engine for tiered coordination across GPU VRAM, system memory, and flash cache.

原文标题：奥睿科推出 FlashMem FM9800 固态硬盘 配备 pSLC AI Cache 区域

Why it matters：这是消费级存储厂商针对本地 AI 推理场景的硬件产品发布，展示了用 pSLC 缓存区承接模型权重的思路，但缺乏实测数据与生态验证。

item.title: TuringFonts Uses Custom Fonts to Block Scraping and Copying
item.description:
TuringFonts proposes a lightweight technique that combines simple substitution ciphers with custom fonts to make text in web pages or PDFs unreadable to crawlers and clipboard copying. It suits hiding sensitive strings like emails and phone numbers or deterring plagiarism, but it is obfuscation rather than encryption and cannot defeat OCR or human reading.

原文标题：TuringFonts 用自定义字体让文本无法被爬取复制

Why it matters：提供了一种低成本的反爬与防复制文本混淆思路，对关注内容保护与前端安全的开发者有参考价值。

item.title: TSMC Outsources CoWoS oS Packaging to Xintec
item.description:
TSMC has signed a capacity outsourcing agreement with Xintec, which will build an advanced packaging line inside TSMC's Central Taiwan facility to handle the oS step of CoWoS heterogeneous integration, procuring its own tools and automated material handling and operating the line, with phase one expected online in 2029. The move signals TSMC is offloading part of the mature CoWoS flow to specialist packaging partners to expand supply amid persistent capacity tightness.

原文标题：台积电将 CoWoS 的 oS 工序外包给精材

Why it matters：CoWoS 是 AI 芯片供给的关键瓶颈，台积电首次将 oS 工序外包给专业封测厂，对算力供应链具有实质影响。

item.title: Alibaba Launches 2.4T-Parameter Qwen4-Max, Cutting Task Costs Over 60%
item.description:
Alibaba's Qwen team has officially launched Qwen4-Max, a 2.4-trillion-parameter sparse MoE flagship with native vision understanding and a 1M-token context window, claiming over 60% lower task cost at comparable performance. The model introduces systematic architectural changes including Gated DeltaNet, Qwen Sparse Attention, Gated Residual and N-gram Embedding, targeting long-horizon professional work in office, coding and research, and is now available via QwenCloud API with smaller open-source variants to follow.

原文标题：阿里发布 2.4 万亿参数 Qwen4-Max 任务成本降超 60%

Why it matters：2.4 万亿参数旗舰正式落地并给出成本降幅与架构细节，是国产大模型竞争格局中的重要节点。

item.title: uBlock Origin Patches One-Click Universal XSS Flaw
item.description:
A researcher disclosed a one-click universal XSS in uBlock Origin (MV2 Firefox build): a malicious site could abuse the element picker to plant trusted filter rules, injecting arbitrary JavaScript into any site. uBO Lite (MV3) was affected by a similar but milder issue. The flaw is now fixed and a GitHub advisory is published.

原文标题：uBlock Origin 曝一键通用 XSS 漏洞

Why it matters：主流浏览器扩展中的通用 XSS 漏洞直接影响海量用户，且揭示了过滤规则信任模型的系统性风险。

item.title: Tencent Leadership Calls for Company-Wide AI Re-Founding
item.description:
Tencent marked its 28th anniversary by publishing an internal leadership podcast that frames AI as an existential priority, calling on every business unit to re-found itself for the AI era and to restructure the organization accordingly. The message stresses proactive efficiency gains over passive cost-cutting, pushes AI-native businesses and products, and cites co-design work between gaming, fintech and security teams and the Hunyuan model.

item.title: Rust-Built Terminal Git Diff Viewer dffy Targets Huge Repositories
item.description:
dffy is a Rust-written terminal Git diff viewer built for repositories as large as the Linux kernel. Rather than computing the full diff upfront, it renders discovered files immediately and processes the rest in the background, so a 13,000-file change opens as fast as a one-line fix. It offers a file tree, split or unified views, single-key actions, and Homebrew or script installation.

原文标题：Rust 编写的终端 Git 差异查看器 dffy 支持超大仓库

Why it matters：面向超大仓库的终端 diff 工具，增量渲染思路对日常代码审查有实际价值。

item.description:

The centerpiece is a fifth HBM packaging line at Onyang, slated for June 2028 production, aimed at turning the Onyang-Cheonan complex into a frontier HBM hub for AI semiconductors.

item.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 Paints via 700,000 Simulated Brushstrokes
item.description:

In a staff demo, the model produced a parking-lot shopping cart using roughly 700,000 simulated brushstrokes, with no external image model or pre-rendered base image.

item.title: Microsoft Quietly Lists WinUI3 Chinese IME with Bing Search and Word Import
item.description:
Microsoft has quietly listed a standalone Chinese pinyin input method on the Microsoft Store, rebuilt with WinUI3 for x64 and Arm64 and pitched as ad-free with a cleaner interface. It adds a richer lexicon covering internet slang, names, places and technical terms, supports personal dictionary import, and can invoke Bing search while typing. The IME installs separately and does not replace the built-in Microsoft Pinyin, making this a routine product update rather than an AI capability release.

item.title: Tor Ships Emergency 0.4.9.17 Fix to Counter Sustained DDoS Attack
item.description:
The Tor Project released security version 0.4.9.17 as a rapid response to an ongoing DDoS attack that has overwhelmed relays with a flood of client circuits. A fix tied to IPv6 handling in relay DoS defenses is flagged as especially important; the team says more defenses and releases are coming and urges all relay operators to upgrade immediately.

item.title: DeepMind 用多智能体将芯片仿真波形转为 SQL 查询
item.description:
Google DeepMind 与哥伦比亚大学联合提出 BTTF 方法，将超过 10 GB 的芯片仿真波形转储压缩为 SQLite 数据库，再由多智能体团队把自然语言问题翻译为 SQL 并校验设计规则。在 150 道专家标注的验证问题上，基于 Gemini 2.5 Pro 的该系统正确率达 95.33%，多智能体分工比单智能体在质量审计上高出 17.3%，代价是 1.96 倍延迟。其核心启示是：面对超大日志与追踪数据，应将其放入可查询数据库而非塞进提示词。

Why it matters：提出将超大仿真波形转为可查询数据库并由多智能体协作调试的实用范式，附有明确基准数据，对智能体工程与芯片验证均有参考价值。
